name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v3350: The silent-window ratchet was red at 6 against a ceiling of 2, and the first thing measured was the INSTRUMENT: scan() attributed negatives at FUNCTION scope, so one assertFalse about an unrelated value marked every window in that function as blind, while the law NAMED each site and said it passes having examined nothing. By AST, asking whether a negative actually CONSUMES the window: 3 genuine, 3 artifacts. Both numbers are now kept and printed - the strict one is what the ratchet judges because it is the population the sentence is true of, the loose one so narrowing a ratchet can never quietly shrink what is in view. THE THREE GENUINE ONES FAILED IN OPPOSITE DIRECTIONS, which is the point: _shelfRefused is 4,057 chars and its law read 1,600, so 61% of the function it polices went unread; window._dossierClose is 112 chars and its law read 260, reaching 148 chars into the NEXT function where an innocent thShelf( would have failed it. Under assertNotIn an under-reach reports an absence it never looked for and an over-reach fails on code the law says nothing about. All three now end where their subject ends - ast for the python one, brace balance for the two JS ones - and each refuses loudly when it cannot bound the region, because assertNotIn over an empty string passes for anything. ⚠ THE WORST DEFECT WAS NOT A LENGTH: test_the_refusal_panel had NO guard on its find, so a rename makes i == -1, src[-1:1599] is a ONE-CHARACTER window, and the negative assertion passes having read a single byte. ⚠ TWO OF MY OWN CLAIMS WERE WRONG AND ARE CORRECTED IN THE LAWS: _src() does NOT preserve line numbers - its pattern lets backslash-s span newlines and control_app.py loses 312 of 35,484 - so the helper slices the RAW file; and the session window was not reading 38% of its subject, it was reaching 200 chars PAST it, because my 1,856 figure counted comments the reader never sees. Silent ratchet 6 to 0, GREEN. Total 63 to 60 against a ceiling of 44, still red and carried: that is a separate 16-window sweep and raising the ceiling instead would be re-blessing a ratchet blind. 475 gates, 5 red-proofs PROVEN.
